Route planning for heavy and abnormal loads in Europe just got another constraint to check. In the Netherlands, the N307 Markerwaarddijk bridges now carry a 15-tonne gross-weight limit and a 7.3-tonne axle-load limit, which matters for any dispatcher whose route relies on this corridor.

Two more items from this week's EU Oversize Weekly (26 October–1 November 2026) are worth a look:

• Italy is restricting derogations for abnormal-load BESS container transports, a point for carriers moving battery storage equipment.
• Trucks reportedly waited up to seven hours at the Batrovci–Bajakovo border crossing.

These items come from sourced operational reports and industry news, so check the details before you dispatch. The full Weekly puts the lead reports in context and links to the sources, so you can verify them yourself.
